newsitem.title: UK: Sallie Mae Trust sets $1.505 billion global bond.
newsitem.headline: Sallie Mae Trust sets $1.505 billion global bond.

text.p: J.P. Morgan has launched a $1.505 billion three-tranche global bond for the Sallie Mae Student Loan Trust 1996-4. The deal is to be priced later today.
The deal comprises an A1-tranche of $957.30 million with spread talk 47-48 b.p. over U.S. Treasuries and an expected average life of 2.397 years. Fees are 0.225 percent.
The A2-tranche of $495.0 million could be priced 63-65 b.p. over Treasuries and has an expected average life of 7.05 years with fees of 0.275 percent.
The certificates are worth $52.70 million and the fees are 0.472 percent.
